title: RERR error_code field not validated against known codes
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs
Line: 480

Issue: The error_code field in Rerr is parsed as raw u8 without validation against known error code values. If the spec defines specific error codes, unknown values should be handled explicitly.

Trigger: Receiving RERR with an undefined error_code value - currently silently accepted.

Impact: Similar to flags - unknown error codes may be valid in future protocol versions or may indicate a malformed/malicious message.

Suggested fix:
1. Define an enum for known error codes (similar to LoadngCode)
2. Either validate in from_bytes() or provide an accessor that returns Option<KnownErrorCode>
close_reason: Invalid: error_code not being validated is intentional for forward compatibility - allows receivers to handle unknown error codes gracefully.
